pulls.title: Add note about not being agent identity
pulls.author: skyfire-ankit
pulls.body: Adding a note to the introduction that KYAPay does NOT aim to define agentic identity. Its aim is to carry agentic identity claims, whatever they may be, from caller to callee.

comments.body:
```suggestion
KYAPay does not aim to define agentic identity in its entirety. Rather, it specifies
a standard and extensible JWT profile for a token that can be used to securely share human
principal and agent identity information with websites and APIs. KYAPay tokens
provide a strong signal of human presence behind agentic requests that are
otherwise indistinguishable from programmatic and potentially malicious bot requests.

```

pulls.title: Follow JWT conventions
pulls.author: selfissued
pulls.body:
Specifically:

- Allow additional claims and values to be defined and used.
- Require that unrecognized claims be ignored.
- Perform versioning with the "typ" header parameter value and claims present rather than a version number.
- Use a boolean-valued claim when the value is effectively true or false.
- Use lowercase names in values.

pulls.title: Drop the "srl" claim to prevent data leakage
pulls.author: skyfire-ankit
pulls.body:
The srl claim will leak data when browser use agents send requests for 3rd party resources while loading the target's URL.

The HTTP referrerpolicy is explicitly designed to prevent this and the recommendation is that the referer header should just be the target domain.
